tools.description: Current GroundTruth and GruntPay plans and prices. Free to call — use it before answering any cost question rather than guessing.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_pricing" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Current GroundTruth and GruntPay plans and prices. Free to call — use it before answering any cost question rather than guessing.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_scan · Public sink: read_scan, draft_estimate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_scan · Public sink: read_scan, draft_estimate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
